contract.status: v5 round 2, which the security review accepted as the design baseline for gate-draft-r4, with v5 change 19 confirmed by the maintainer decision named here. A design baseline: it approves no implementation, this draft included, and no release. The arrays are its C23 arrays

pending.darwin-full: its reviewed full-test file set and its array do not exist yet (v5 C23)
pending.entries: each entry's evidence paths and types, parser, tool identity, allowed statuses and bounds (v5 C23, C17 item 12)
pending.order: the separate N and O phase records with the grant between them, and the order rules that need records this draft does not make: each build complete in its pre-build authority before its RUN steps, its same-run result record sealed and verified before any use, systemd-test-image verifying its own result, and the trusted bootstrap's check before any stage (v5 C1, C3, C5, C23). This draft runs N and O as one local run: it checks the other C23 order rules on the recorded intervals of its stages, and that platform-manifest and candidate-policy end before every stage that executes candidate code; the rest of what the end of phase N would order is pending
pending.record-forms: the exact forms of the T8 records, each build's pre-build authority record, the same-run result record and t8-image-activation's binding record, with their producers, parsers, evidence paths, bounds and statuses (v5 C5, C17 item 12): until they are reviewed, the three T8 stages, both image builds and container-identity are pending and neither image build starts; the test stages, whose tests may build images (their TEST_REQUIRE includes docker) with no such record, stay pending too
pending.record-pack-bounds: the record-pack profile's path, depth and byte bounds and their workload fit, and an entry-count and byte bound for a companion run folder: the decided counts approve none of them (v5 C21, C24)
pending.scanners: each scanner's raw-record contract (v5 C15, C23); the membership is the starting catalog that the security review of v3 accepted
